decision: Chi KHONG DUYET bo tach lop v14 (ve lai be/ghe/bang/ban/May va doi phong cach). Ban chuan duy nhat la May_home_red_viewer_v13c.png; v15 chi di chuyen hop phim tren chinh pixel cua ban chuan.
method: Buoc 1: Muse Image EDIT chinh v13c dung 1 luot chi xoa hop do tren hien va va san (raw_edit_without_viewer.png).
Buoc 2: Canvas cuoi la ORIGINAL v13c; chi dan mieng va cua raw trong patch_bbox de tao nen B. Ngoai bbox la pixel ORIGINAL.
Buoc 3: Trich hop vuong tu ORIGINAL bang alpha mask polygon silhouette (work/viewer_extracted.png), khong AI ve lai hop.
Buoc 4: Ke go tao moi 1 luot tren nen magenta + tach alpha bang keyout.py (PIL/NumPy); ghep hop+ke bang PIL thanh C, roi alpha_composite vao vi tri moi tren B de tao A.
known_deviations: Mieng va san hien lay tu raw edit (AI) nen ben trong patch_bbox net san co the khac nhe ORIGINAL; day la vung duy nhat cua B/A khong phai pixel goc, dung chu dich cua phuong phap.
Mask polygon trich hop con mot vet nen rat nho (vai px) sat phia phai tay quay va duoi mep cheo phai cua hop; o kich thuoc dat 130px gan nhu khong thay.
Ke go moi co texture mau nuoc ro hon cac mang mau sach cua v13c; da bao chi. Ke chi la vat moi duoc phep tao, hop la pixel goc.
